title: High-performance asymmetric supercapacitors based on a 3D Ti3C2TX@NiCo2S4-reduced graphene oxide hydrogel positive electrode
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00192G, Paper
Shuwei Zhang, Xinmiao Liu, Xin Zhang, Wenjie Yan, Haijun Xu, Zenghui Qiu
A high-energy Ti3C2TX@NiCo2S4-RGO//DRGO asymmetric supercapacitor device is assembled based on the 3D Ti3C2TX@NiCo2S4-RGO hydrogel positive electrode and 3D DRGO hydrogel negative electrode.
